description: NFL expansion draft and relocation events with rules for player selection

events.name: 1976 Seahawks & Buccaneers Expansion Draft
events.description: The NFL added two new teams: Seattle Seahawks and Tampa Bay Buccaneers

rules.description: Each existing team could protect 32 players. Expansion teams selected 39 players each over 8 rounds.

events.name: 1995 Panthers & Jaguars Expansion Draft
events.description: Carolina Panthers and Jacksonville Jaguars joined the NFL

rules.description: Each existing team protected 36 players. Expansion teams alternated selections for 6 rounds.

events.name: Cleveland Browns Relocation to Baltimore
events.description: Art Modell moved the Cleveland Browns to Baltimore. All players, staff, and team history transferred to become the Baltimore Ravens.

rules.description: All players from Cleveland moved to Baltimore. The Browns franchise was suspended with the agreement that Cleveland would receive a new expansion team by 1999.

inactiveTeam.reason: Browns franchise suspended until expansion team in 1999

events.name: 1999 Cleveland Browns Return Expansion Draft
events.description: The new Cleveland Browns franchise selected players in an expansion draft to begin play in 1999

rules.description: Each existing team protected 33 players. Browns selected 37 players, max 1 per team.

events.name: 2002 Houston Texans Expansion Draft
events.description: The Houston Texans became the NFL's 32nd franchise

rules.description: Each existing team protected only 15 players. Texans could take max 1 from each team. 30 players selected total.

draftPickCompensation.description: Expansion teams received draft picks. Teams listed get picks at positions specified per round.

1976.note: Seahawks and Bucs received extra picks in 1976 draft

1995.note: Panthers and Jaguars alternated throughout the draft
